description: Create a Mako Metrics order brief for a customer and return a Stripe checkout link for them to complete payment. After payment, we email the customer when the report is ready, typically within 24h. They download the PDF report and export ZIP (saved ad images/videos, browsable gallery, raw ad data) at makometrics.com/portal. No payment is taken by this tool. It only returns a pay link the human opens. Report plans only. For May, the Meta ads agent, send the customer to makometrics.com/meta-ads-agent.

client_account_name.description: Required for the agency plan: the client this batch is for.

competitors.description: Brand or Meta Ad Library page names. Snapshot=1, Dominator=up to 5, Agency=up to 10.

email.description: Customer work email (receipt, portal invite, and report-ready notifications).
